description: Ask the assigned TypeSafe Jev model bounded questions or score filtered files discovered in an authorized directory.
skill_summary: Use JSON for open-ended decisions, or filter and score directory files without listing them first. Optional source excerpts need automatic file_read permission.
migration_note: Native Rust adapter uses the agent's explicit Decision model role and its current V3 credential. TypeSafe is the supported transport. No V2 secret or code is used.
